cases.input: A repository moves from one provider URL to another while retaining complete revision history and governance ownership.
cases.expect: The repository identity remains stable and a successor locator binding records the migration.

cases.input: One monorepo contains components used by three products.
cases.expect: One repository identity references three external product or component bindings without merging product identities.

cases.input: An archived repository revision is cited by a historical build and release.
cases.expect: The revision and provenance remain resolvable although the repository is read-only or archived.

cases.input: A production build records only branch main as its source input.
cases.expect: The build is non-reproducible until main is resolved and pinned to an immutable repository revision.

cases.input: A provider URL change automatically creates a new repository identity.
cases.expect: The new identity is rejected unless governance and lineage prove an independent repository or fork.

cases.input: Repository metadata stores a deploy key and reversible token digest.
cases.expect: The record is rejected because only protected credential references may be retained.

cases.input: A repository record is treated as the Software Product and inherits its deployment status.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected; repository, product and deployment have distinct identities and lifecycles.
